results.title: Mali drone strike kills 13 civilians, activists say; army says it targeted militants - The Washington Post
results.snippet:
BAMAKO, Mali — At least 13 civilians were killed in an overnight drone strike by Mali’s military earlier this week near the border with Mauritania, local human rights activists and a separatist armed group said Wednesday.

The Malian military said in a statement Wednesday that it had targeted terrorists “gathered under cover.”
